name: URTC-COMMON
notes: The CAN protocol of the tool head as data: spec/can_protocol.json holds every identifier with its direction, length rule and payload layout, the magic payloads, the registers of the expansion slave, the version procedures, the SLCAN subset the host tools rely on and the multi-node section. Generators write a C header, a TypeScript module and a Python module (constants plus pure frame builders and parsers), conformance vectors are written and checked, and a Python package offers the SLCAN codec, the transports and the interface helpers the desktop tools share. FLASHER, TESTER and WEB-STUDIO carry checked copies (tools/vendor_copy.py); the tests that compare the specification with the other repositories skip when those are not next to this one.
